reviews.author: 首尔上门服务Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Overall, this restaurant was a great experience and I would definitely go back. The signature dish, braised pork belly, was a beautiful reddish-brown color, had a rich flavor but was not greasy, and melted in your mouth, making a perfect harmony with the rice. The steamed sea bass was also very fresh and cooked to perfection. The atmosphere was elegant, and the space between seats was wide, creating a comfortable dining atmosphere. The staff were friendly and attentive. However, food service was a bit slow during peak hours, so we had to wait about 30 minutes for our main dish. The price is a bit high at about 150 yuan per person, but it is acceptable considering the quality and taste of the ingredients. Ideal for family gatherings or business dinners, reservations are recommended. If service efficiency is improved, it will be an even better experience. Overall, I would like to recommend this restaurant to my friends as it is a restaurant that shows sincerity and dedication.

reviews.text: There are mainly restaurants, grocery stores, and various general stores, and you can find unique and rare products. Restaurants vary depending on the type of food they serve, but overall, the value for money is not bad. Bindaetteok, located in the center of the market, is a recommended menu item. There are several stores. Overall, it is crowded and you can find a lot of foreigners. The accessibility of the market itself is good.

reviews.author: Yusion
reviews.text:
My personal rating of 4 stars is that it is definitely worth a visit at least once.
It's easy to get to Gwangjang Market by getting off at Jongno 5-ga Station on Line 1 and taking exits 7 and 8.
Prices and sizes are the same at each store, but do you really need to come here for this price? Thoughts.

There are a few shops where the sanitary condition of the street stalls is questionable. Nevertheless, since it is a market, there are not only things to eat. There are also many shops selling side dishes, clothes, blankets, medicine, snacks, etc., so please keep in mind.

At every entrance to the market, trash cans, disposable plastic cups, and food waste are rolling around in extremely filthy condition. I think this part needs to be improved.

reviews.author: HAVI PARK
reviews.text:
A place where you can see and taste a variety of Korean foods all in one place. I think it is the most famous mayor of Seoul among foreigners as it is often introduced in foreign programs and Netflix. It is much more crowded than Namdaemun Market next to Myeongdong. Octopus, bindaetteok, noodles, etc. are really delicious and the prices are not expensive. Desserts are expensive, but still worth eating once or twice. It's been a long time since I went and ate live octopus, bindaetteok, fruit juice, and twisted squid, and I want to go again. I will have to go back soon for the market dumpling soup, bindaetteok, and makgeolli.
Aquí es donde puedes asegurarte un lugar a través de una variedad de combatientes coreanos. It's amazing to see in Australia. Hay mucha más gente que el mercado Namdaemun al lado de Myeongdong. Camel, Bindaetteok, fideos, etc. son realmente inconvenientes. Todavía como postre al menos una vez. Después de mucho tiempo, quiero volver a probar el pulpo vivo, el bindaetteok, el zumo de frutas y las conservas klipbaegi. La sopa de bola de masa del mercado, el bindaetteok y el makgeolli comenzarán de nuevo pronto.

reviews.author: Yeon Woo Kim
reviews.text:
Park next to Geukripjung Children's Hospital in Euljiro 5-ga.
There is a statue of General Kwon Yul.
There are several state board structures installed in the park.

At the site of the training center, there was a training center that was in charge of classes such as martial arts training for soldiers and military combat formations. The training center was established in the first year of King Taejo of the Joseon Dynasty (1392) and was initially called the training center. It was moved here during the reign of King Taejong and built Sacheong, a main hall where martial arts such as archery were practiced and martial arts exams were held to the south of the building. It was renamed to a training center in the 12th year of King Sejo's reign (1466). Before the current training center park and parking lot were built, there was a wooden building decorated with red bricks and the internal structure built by land transport that was cut down from Mt. Baekdu and transported to the Yellow Sea along the Yalu River. We tried to preserve the old scent by processing the wood recovered during the demolition of this building and using it to unveil an information board. It opened on June 30, 1997, and is equipped with landscaping facilities such as a lawn, drinking fountain, and fog fountain, as well as convenient facilities such as a management office, restrooms, and benches.

reviews.author: jay Kim
reviews.text:
It's nice to have an underground parking lot when using Bangsan Market, Flea Market, Gwangjang Market, etc. nearby. There is a clean park on the ground and a parking lot in the basement. Training Center Park is said to be the place where the Japanese disbanded the Korean army in 1907. When they were disbanded, they gave silver and gold, but some did not accept it and participated in volunteer activities. These are really great soldiers.
It's a good place to escape the busy daily life in the city and cool off. However, it's not nice to see some homeless people gathering and drinking together. Still, I hope you work hard to support yourself.
